summary: Lead research for MyTrip MVP (travel/tourism trip planning). Targets regional CVBs, wine tour operators, and attractions that could benefit from itinerary builders, trip planners, and visitor engagement tools.

leads.fit_rationale: Official county tourism site promoting 30+ wineries, 19 covered bridges, state parks, and fishing. A trip planner/itinerary builder would enhance visitor engagement and length of stay.
Promotes Ohio's first summer resort area; trip planning tools with lodging/attraction bundling could drive bookings and extend visits.
Offers wine and covered bridge tours; an integrated trip planner with booking/reservation features would streamline their operations.
Features 100+ barn quilts plus wineries/bridges. A trip planning tool with mapped routes and suggested itineraries would improve visitor experience.

leads.organization: Premier Transportation Service / Vines & Wines Wine Trail
leads.fit_rationale: Provides wine tours, wedding transport, and custom itineraries. Trip planning integration with booking would be valuable.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add an interactive itinerary builder with drag-and-drop attractions.
Include day-trip and weekend-trip preset templates (winery tour, covered bridge tour, family fun).
Integrate lodging availability and booking CTAs within itineraries.
Add shareable trip links for groups/families planning together.
Include weather-aware suggestions (indoor vs outdoor activities).
Provide printable/downloadable itinerary PDFs for offline use.
Add trip cost estimator with per-attraction pricing.

possible_issues: If the trip planner lacks visual hierarchy, users may miss key attractions.
Without clear CTAs, visitors may not complete bookings.
Poor mobile responsiveness would hurt on-the-go trip planning.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Trip planning tools can be branded for specific CVBs, tour operators, or attractions with minimal customization.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Reach out to Visit Ashtabula County and Geneva-on-the-Lake CVB with trip planner demos.
Explore partnerships with wine tour operators for bundled itinerary+booking offerings.
